receipt.confirmReplace: A receipt is already attached to this invoice. Replace it? The previous receipt will be deleted from the server.

tour.calc_step2_body: Use this button to add a gluten-free product line to your invoice. A small wizard will open to guide you.
tour.calc_step2_hint: Click it now to open the item wizard.
tour.calc_save_body: Your gluten-free item is now on the invoice. Save it to go back to the demo home and continue with the comparison.
tour.calc_save_hint: Click “Save” now; you’ll be returned to the demo home screen.
tour.calc_modal_step1_body: Pick the gluten-free product type (bread, pasta, cereal, etc.). This will be used later for the comparison.
tour.calc_modal_step1_hint: Click “Next” when you’ve selected the correct type.
tour.calc_modal_step2_body: Enter the brand/product name, quantity, price and weight. This is what the calculator will use to compute the per-100g (or per-unit) cost.
tour.calc_modal_step2_hint: When everything looks good, click “Add item” to save it to the invoice.
